subtitle.name: Subtitle extension
subtitle.description: Off by default. Words you add with + in video subtitles (Subtitle browser extension) become cards in a deck, with the line, its translation, a screenshot and the audio. Only this computer can connect, with an access key you create here.

examples.name: Best example
examples.description: Ranks the scenes of a word by how easy they are to learn from: unknown words besides the word (names do not count), whole sentence or a cut line, sound and picture, common words around it. Says why, and spots the same line captured twice.

default_deck.label: Deck for Subtitle cards
default_deck.description: Deck id that captures go to when the extension names none. Empty: a deck called Subtitle, made on first use. Easier to choose on the Subtitle page.

share_known_words.label: Share known words with Subtitle
share_known_words.description: Off: the extension only sends words here. On: it may also read which words you know or are learning, to colour subtitles.

same_word.label: When a word you already have comes again
same_word.description: Another example: a new scene of a word you already have a card for, with the same meaning, is added to that card as another example (no new card; its schedule stays). A different meaning gets its own card and asks you once. New card: every line is a new card (as before v1.4).

auto_best_example.label: Show the best example by itself
auto_best_example.description: Off: a new scene of a word is only added as another example; the card keeps showing the one it has. On: when the new scene is clearly easier to learn from (fewer unknown words, a whole sentence, sound and picture), the card shows it instead. Undo brings the old one back; the card's schedule never changes.

subtitle.heading: Subtitle
subtitle.intro: Words you add with + while watching videos with the Subtitle browser extension arrive here as cards. You connect the extension once; after that you rarely need this page.
subtitle.load_failed: Could not load the Subtitle settings.

connect.title: Connect the extension
connect.description: You connect (pair) the extension with this app using an access key. The connection only works while this app is open, and only from this computer.
connect.address_hint: Paste this into the “server address” field in the extension's settings.
connect.step1: Create an access key below and copy it.
connect.step2: In the extension open Ayarlar → Öğrenme servisi (Settings → Learning service), pick Subtitle Kartları and paste the server address and the key.
connect.step3: Click Bağlantıyı test et (Test connection). From then on every word you add with + arrives here.

keys.title: Access keys
keys.description: A key is the password the extension needs to add cards to this app. Create one per browser. Revoke a key you no longer use: that browser can no longer connect, right away.
keys.name: Key name
keys.new_body: Copy it now and paste it into the extension.
keys.once: You won’t see this key again once you close this window. If you lose it, create a new one.

deck.title: Where cards go
deck.description: If you picked a deck in the extension, words go there; otherwise to the deck chosen here.
deck.label: Deck

received.some: {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} received, last {time}.
received.label: Words received

deck.hint: The deck cards go to when the extension names none. Changing it only affects words that arrive from now on; cards already here stay where they are.
deck.example: Right now → new words go to the “{deck}” deck.

off.title: The Subtitle extension is off
off.body: Turn it on and the extension can connect to the app on this computer. You can also switch it in Settings → Modules.

how.title: How it works
how.capture: While watching a video in your browser, you press the + next to a word in the subtitles.
how.sent: The extension sends the word and the subtitle sentence it appeared in to this app, plus, when it has them, the meaning, a translation of the sentence, a screenshot and the audio of that moment, and a link to that second of the video.
how.card: It becomes a card in your chosen deck: the word and the sentence on the front (the word in bold), meaning, translation, picture and audio on the back. It goes straight into the deck, not through the inbox.
how.repeat: Adding the same word from the same sentence again makes no second card. The same word from another sentence makes a new card.
